rule: Make one primary action visually dominant
do_pattern: Single primary button with strongest contrast
One H1 then logical H2/H3 sections
dont_pattern: Skipping levels or repeating multiple H1s

do_pattern: Limit line length for body copy
dont_pattern: Very wide text blocks on desktop
Start with company history before value

dont_code: Home, Product, Platform, Solutions, Industries, Resources, Blog, Docs, Partners, Careers

do_pattern: Visible focus states on all controls

dont_code: Company, role, team size, phone, budget, timeline

do_pattern: Use correct keyboard and validation hints
dont_pattern: Using generic text for all fields

do_code: Password must be at least 12 characters

dont_pattern: Silent navigation away from unsaved form

do_pattern: Accept spaces/dashes in phone or card input
dont_pattern: Reject user input due to formatting only

do_pattern: Show response under 100 ms or immediate visual feedback
do_code: Button shows loading state after click

do_pattern: Show what happened and what is next
do_code: Saved. You can now invite teammates.
Payment failed. Try another card or contact support.

dont_pattern: Show all advanced controls by default
Internal technical terms as UI copy

rule: Place helper text near relevant fields
dont_pattern: Helper info far from related control

rule: Do not rely on color alone
do_pattern: Pair color with icon or text state

rule: Provide alt text for meaningful images
dont_pattern: Decorative or empty alt on informative image

rule: Ensure touch targets are large enough

do_code: Hero with concise message and one CTA
dont_pattern: Large decorative block pushes CTA below fold
dont_code: Hero image occupies full first screen

do_pattern: Sticky CTA does not hide content
Render skeletons for key content areas
dont_pattern: Blank screen until all data loads

rule: Show social proof near decision points
do_pattern: Place testimonials beside pricing or CTA
do_code: Quote block next to plan cards

do_pattern: Show total cost and billing cadence

rule: Include policy links near conversion forms
do_pattern: Privacy and terms linked at submit point
do_code: By continuing you agree to Terms and Privacy.
dont_pattern: Policies buried in site footer only

do_pattern: Limit primary options to most relevant set
do_code: 3 plan cards with clear best fit
dont_pattern: 7 similar plan cards with minor differences

do_pattern: CTA appears after testimonials or case studies
do_code: Section ends with Get started button
dont_pattern: Only one CTA at top of long page

do_pattern: Real constraints only: deadlines, inventory, cohort

dont_code: User must set every option manually

dont_pattern: Long flow loses progress on refresh

do_pattern: Show why each result matches query
dont_pattern: Unclear ranking with no match context
